text_block_list.text: —Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Mm~, okay, looking good! 
Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone~! 
Ready, and!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The Val-Fan-Meet has officially started! 
Was everyone looking forward to it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I was totally looking forward to it!" 
Thank you~♪ 
Curren and the others prepared a whole lot 
for today too♡

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, everyone is so sharp. They noticed 
right away. 
Mar-Zephyr's new look.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"So cute"... 
For this stream, we have dressed up in new 
sweet outfits.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, "We want to see the full outfits"? 
...In that case, Machan-san. Let us create 
a breeze together—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Spin, spin~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Woow, the "So cute!" spam is incredible! 
Makes sense, right~♪ 
Just for today... Curren and the girls are 
all yours♡

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't Curren-chan and the others wearing 
them?" ...Well, about that, 
we actually have some unfortunate news...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, that is not good. "Unfortunate 
news means..." 
"You're not wearing them?" "So sad"... 
They are getting the wrong idea.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, sorry, sorry, that's not what I 
meant! 
We're wearing them, we're totally wearing 
them! My bad, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look forward to our costume change 
later on too, okay?♪ Everyone, 
keep those comments coming! Let's have a 
nice, cozy chat♡

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, is that about it for answering 
the messages we got? 
Let's see... hm, "Use a filter"? ...Ah, 
was it this one?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! So lovely! Well, how about this for 
now... 
"Nature, do a finger heart"—Oops, cut 
that, my bad.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! 
Now is the time to comment, comment!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, stop spamming the "＜●＞＜●＞" 
stare~! 
............Ugh, I get it, alright! I 
already steeled my resolve for today 
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But still... Curren, heeeeelp meeeeee.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, so cute♪ 
Let's definitely do it together♡ Ready, 
set, go!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaah! How's that! Satisfied now?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, here we go. Everyone, please 
send in your supportive comments... 
Lots of them, please.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Well then—here I go!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
How does it look...? 
—Ha...! Amazing! Only the deer is blurred!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah... so much applause, ...! 
Thanks to everyone's support, I... feel 
like I can become a selfie master!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Is everyone having fun? 
If anyone hasn't chimed in yet... please 
do.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, you over there too... don't 
hesitate, now is the time. 
Come, come on, how about it?
choice_data_list: Running without giving up is the best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, 'Cute Curren Chan'! Found a Curren 
fan! 
Here's a little fan service just for 
you... hyah♡ and then, mwah♡

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, all good things must come to an 
end, and it's almost time to say goodbye. 
..."Ehhhh!!" Yes, that's what I was 
waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, 'I'm watching, Chan-chan'... 
Yes, Chan-chan is... watching you closely 
too. Staaare.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, all good things must come to an 
end, and it's almost time to say goodbye. 
..."Ehhhh!!" Yes, that's what I was 
waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Fufufu... someone is sending a breeze 
my way. 
...Sway, sway...—...I'm awake, you know.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, all good things must come to an 
end, and it's almost time to say goodbye. 
..."Ehhhh!!" Yes, that's what I was 
waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, 'Seeing you never give up and keep 
running is the best!'... it says. 
I get it, I totally get it, that whole 
sparkling youth vibe. So, who is it for—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oh, both of our names are there. Well 
then, to answer their cheers... 
Nature-san, are you ready? Here we go... 
cool pose!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, all good things must come to an 
end, and it's almost time to say goodbye. 
..."Ehhhh!!" Yes, that's what I was 
waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. Valen-Fami is packed full of 
love until the very end. 
Which means... the final corner: 
screenshot giveaway time!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
We've also received many requests for 
chocolate. 
To answer that... let's start with 
Nature-san and Ikuno-san...—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ehh!? Ikuno, are you seriously saying 
that!? 
This outfit is already embarrassing 
enough... ah, no, not that I won't do 
it... Gaaah, fine!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, everyone, you heard nothing. 
Shh. 
Now once again... Nature-san, Ikuno-san, 
take it away!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno & Nature
text_block_list.text:
Here, say aah♪ 
S-Say aah...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Here is some special chocolate for 
everyone. 
Please accept it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! Are you guys really happy with 
this...? 
The comments totally stopped, too...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that everyone is busy taking 
screenshots? 
...Ah, look. Someone commented, 'Spamming 
the shutter.'

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Spam-minnng...............? 
........Ugh, p-please delete them right 
away, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—And that's that! Screenshot time is over. 
Did everyone manage to get a good shot?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the turn of the speedy trio, 
including Chan-chan. 
Oh, looks like Curren-san is done with her 
outfit change too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well then, we'll be moving over... so in 
the meantime, everyone, 
please prepare your drinks. Let's make a 
toast together.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's do a countdown~! 
Three, two, one... ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Group
text_block_list.text: Cheers♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Today is a special Valentine's Day to 
spend with you♡ 
Get ready to have your heart throb a whole 
bunch, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let us engrave these sweet, sweet memories 
deep, deeeep into each other's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And together, moving past this winter 
barrenness... 
if we could feel the warm spring breeze... 
I would be truly happy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Did everyone enjoy themselves today? 
—Fufu. Thank you, thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Spending time with everyone that felt like 
the easterly wind of spring... 
was a truly heart-stirring moment..

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
May today remain in all of your hearts 
as a specially fun and cherished memory.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, to finish off... we'd like to 
unite our hearts with everyone 
and close out by interacting together, 
but——... ah.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Well then! Please give us a 'danmaku' 
barrage of comments! 
Flood the screen with everyone's 'Happy 
Valentine's'!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let us stir up... a storm of feelings. 
...May I lead the call? 
...Well then, ready, set...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...—— 
A beautiful breeze,.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's, Happy Valentine's. 
Drawing strength from your feelings, next 
time I'll return the favor... in a 
different form.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's, Happy Valentine's... 
Well then, see you... all again. ...Hup.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Or so you thought, hup. 
...Fufu, this time for real—bye-bye.
“The live stream has ended.”
